title: Sigil and Oath
author: Theo Crane
blurb: Lior Marchetti, a cartographer of unmapped realms, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
